repos_data.description: Spatial audio for any headphones on Mac: 7.1 surround with head tracking for every app, Netflix in 5.1 in Safari, AI upmix for stereo, and a live 3D view of the sound.

Native macOS menu-bar app for Sony headphones. Switch Noise Cancelling / Ambient Sound, adjust ambient level, toggle Speak-to-Chat and check the battery, no phone needed. Supports WH-1000XM4/XM5/XM6, WF-1000XM4/XM5, LinkBuds S and more.
